about: Contact rules as data (gen/details/brief_contacts.md; tools/contact_check.mjs reads them). clips.<clip>: posture, contacts [{site, target, feature?, gap_m, pen_m, hold}], why. A contact PASSes when, over every sample of the clip at 10 Hz, the signed distance (gap > 0, penetration < 0) stays <= gap_m and >= -pen_m for at least `hold` of the cycle (the hold-quantile). Sites: tools/joint_tracks.mjs. Written by gen/details/contacts/tools/make_contacts_json.py.

postures.stand: standing: stance soles on the surface under them; standing-on-furniture and body checks apply
postures.squat: squatting or crouching: soles on the surface (a looser stance check), body checks apply
postures.walk: walking: checked at the dump instant (soles not judged: mid-stride)
postures.chair: seated on a raised seat: the seat rule replaces the stance soles; the seat owner is exempt from the body checks
postures.floor: seated on the floor: the seat on whatever surface is under it (ground included)
postures.lie: lying: the hips on the surface
postures.ride: on an animal: placed by the page every frame; seat on the ridden animal's back

targets.vehicle: the vehicle (S*.veh.*) in the figure's map group, else the nearest vehicle owner within 4 m; feature 'rod': its long thin pieces found by connectivity (push bars, handles, rails: >= 0.5 m long, <= 0.08 m thick), 'pole': the same >= 1.5 m long (sedan poles, shafts); distance to the piece's axis minus its radius. Without a feature: the vehicle's nearest visible surface
targets.seat: the highest non-ground surface (any owner, collide or not, visible) under the seat point, from 0.15 m above it; none = the ground (sits on air): gap = seat - ground
targets.floor: the highest surface under the site from 0.15 m above it, the ground included
targets.rail: the nearest visible non-ground surface (structures, buildings, props, vehicles) within 0.6 m of the site; signed (inside a closed piece = negative)
targets.animal: the people.json animal in the figure's map group (S*.ani.*), else the nearest within 4 m: its posed mesh (body + its load's tack) at the page's spot, yaw and scale (frame 0 of its current clip); signed by vertical-ray parity
targets.ridden: the animal the rider sits on (people.json ride): its posed mesh with its load
targets.self-prop: a carried prop bound to the clip by construction: skipped
targets.boat: fix-boats: the crew member's own boat (people_dump boats: its root and node matrices at the instant; gen/sections/<name>/boat_owners.*), by feature: sweep (the sweep node's visible pieces), oar (the oar nodes), tiller (the body's rods within 0.35 m of pt_tiller), line (its line_* ropes as segments less their radius, and its rope pieces); without a feature its nearest visible piece
targets.pole: fix-boats: the figure's own carried pole (people.json props long_pole*; tools/prop_tracks.mjs): distance to its axis less its radius
targets.water: fix-boats: a pole end (site pole_lo, the lower end) under or at the water surface, or on the highest visible surface under it (deck, bank, ground): gap = height over that surface (0 under the water); a solid surface above the water counts with penetration
targets.reach: fix-boats: a pole end (site pole_far, the end away from the right hand) on the nearest visible surface that is not its own boat or body (a bank, a bridge, another boat), or at the water surface

stance_soles.how: per sample the lower sole's height over the highest surface under it (from 0.25 m above the sole); judged on the median over every clip of the cycle

furniture.how: root H minus the ground owner's height under the root, when the map support is ground (or none); the owner the root stands on is named

order.how: the root as placed (dump) vs the ground hook with every section loaded (tools/place_predict.mjs): a figure placed before a neighbour section streamed in stands elsewhere when the world loads in another order

body_cylinder.how: collide triangles (edge walls left out) within BODY_R of the root's vertical axis in plan, inside the height band above the root; the figure's own contact targets and seat are exempt

head_inside.how: head_top inside any visible closed piece (collide or not: roofs are nocol): odd vertical-ray parity up and down on that owner, depth = distance to its nearest triangle; over the cycle

site_inside.how: a body site inside a visible closed piece of a collide owner (walls, tables, cabins, other vehicles), deeper than pen_m, over the cycle; the clip's own contact targets allow their pen_m
